2609.09119.title: DeCAL: Towards Physically-Grounded Dexterous Vision-Language-Action Models via Contact-Aware Latent Co-Imagination
2609.09119.paper_summary: Dexterous manipulation involves contact-rich and fine-grained interactions with the physical world, posing significant challenges for existing vision-language-action (VLA) models due to severe visual occlusions and complex contact dynamics. While recent works have incorporated tactile sensing into robotic manipulation, most approaches still rely on homogeneous multimodal fusion, lacking adaptive tactile integration and explicit modeling of physical dynamics. In this work, we present DeCAL, a physically-grounded dexterous vision-language-action model that unifies understanding, imagination and action generation for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. Built upon a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture, DeCAL leverages specialized experts for each capability while enabling efficient information flow among them. To effectively leverage tactile information, we introduce Adaptive Visuo-Tactile Fusion that dynamically regulates tactile interactions via a contact-aware gating strategy. Furthermore, we propose Visuo-Tactile Latent Co-Imagination to jointly model visual and tactile dynamics, equipping the policy with implicit physical world knowledge. Experimental results show that DeCAL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across all tasks, attaining a 71% average success rate and an 83.4% progress success rate, while also demonstrating strong generalization to unseen scenarios. The website is available at https://aureleopku.github.io/DeCAL.
2609.09119.paper_summary_zh: 靈巧的操作涉及與物理世界的接觸豐富且細緻的互動，這對現有的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型提出了重大挑戰，因為存在嚴重的視覺遮擋和複雜的接觸動力學。雖然最近的研究已將觸覺感知納入機器人操作中，但大多數方法仍依賴於同質的多模態融合，缺乏自適應的觸覺整合和明確的物理動力學建模。在這項工作中，我們提出了DeCAL，一個基於物理的靈巧視覺-語言-行動模型，統一了理解、想像和行動生成，以應對接觸豐富的靈巧操作。DeCAL基於混合Transformer（MoT）架構，利用專門的專家來處理每種能力，同時促進它們之間的高效信息流。為了有效利用觸覺信息，我們引入了自適應視覺-觸覺融合，通過接觸感知的閘控策略動態調節觸覺互動。此外，我們提出了視覺-觸覺潛在共同想像，以共同建模視覺和觸覺動力學，為策略提供隱含的物理世界知識。實驗結果顯示，DeCAL在所有任務中持續達到最先進的性能，平均成功率為71%，進展成功率為83.4%，同時在未見場景中也展現出強大的泛化能力。網站可訪問 https://aureleopku.github.io/DeCAL。
